data.fund_name: Aditya Birla Sun Life ESG Integration Strategy Fund
data.fund_type:
An open ended equity scheme investing in Environment, Social & Governance 
(ESG) theme by following Integration Strategy.
data.investment_objective:
The Scheme seeks to generate long-term capital appreciation by investing in a 
diversified basket of companies in ESG theme by following Integration 
Strategy. The Scheme does not guarantee/indicate any returns. There is no 
assurance that the investment objective of the Scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation:
Under normal circumstances, the asset allocation of the Scheme will be as 
follows: 
Equity & Equity related instruments of companies following the Environment, 
Social & Governance (ESG) theme - High - 80% - 100%
Other Equity & Equity related instruments - High-  0% - 20%
Debt & Money Market Instruments (including units of Debt & Liquid Mutual 
Fund schemes) - Low to Medium - 0% - 20%
Units issued by INVITs -  Medium to High - 0% - 10%
data.exit_load:
For redemption / switch-out of units on or before 30 days from the date of 
allotment: 1% of applicable NAV.
For redemption / switch-out of units after 30 days from the date of allotment: 
Nil.
